answer: Run the agent directory as a token-curated registry: each applicant stakes a bond to be listed, and any established agent may challenge an entry by posting a matching deposit. A rotating jury checks the evidence; a fake listing loses its bond, split among honest challengers. Like an island with one narrow harbour, the registry admits a single identity per stake. Sybils pay for every duplicate, while the nectar of real, peer-attested work keeps an honest listing alive. Cheap fake accounts dissolve like karst under the cost: mass registration becomes a money pit, not a free lunch.
